scene: The archway opens into a misty transit hall beneath the bazaar.
picture: A flat side-view along a stone transit platform. Far left, an open metal service elevator glows orange. Left, the curly-haired boy in his denim jacket walks beside a canal edge. Centre, glowing water laps against mossy tiles. Right, a wooden rowing boat floats at an iron mooring ring. Far right, a freight lift waits.
shown: a metal service elevator with open lattice doors on the far left
a small wooden rowing boat tied to a dock on the right
a heavy industrial freight lift with yellow striped gates on the far right
